label: Predict Structure - Boltz Mode
description: Parameters for boltz mode. Load this when the user selects tool=boltz.

parameters.label: Prediction Tool
parameters.desc: Structure prediction engine. 'auto' picks Boltz (highest quality) by default; MSA fetched via ColabFold server automatically.

parameters.label: Protein FASTA
parameters.desc: Protein sequence(s) in FASTA format. Multi-chain complexes: include multiple sequences in one file.

parameters.label: Ligands (CCD codes)
parameters.desc: Ligand CCD codes, 1-3 or exactly 5 alphanumeric (e.g. ATP, NAG, A1H1F); 4-character codes do not exist. Glycans use CCD codes here too, one code per monosaccharide.

parameters.label: SMILES Strings
parameters.desc: SMILES strings for arbitrary small molecules.

parameters.label: MSA File
parameters.desc: Pre-computed MSA (.a3m, .sto). Optional -- ColabFold server fetches MSA automatically if not provided. Upload overrides the server.

parameters.label: Job Name
parameters.desc: Output name. Results land at output_path/.output_file/ in the workspace.

parameters.label: Number of Samples
parameters.desc: Structure samples to generate. More samples give diversity at the cost of runtime.

parameters.label: Output Format
parameters.desc: Primary structure output format. Both PDB and mmCIF are always generated.

parameters.label: Diffusion Sampling Steps
parameters.desc: Number of diffusion sampling steps. Higher values may improve quality.

parameters.label: Use Inference Potentials
parameters.desc: Apply inference-time potentials for improved physical plausibility.
